svg.title: Binomial CDFs and central limit theorem
svg.desc: Exact sums of binomial masses for n 10, 30, 100 and p 0.2. Standardized variables remain discrete for each finite n.

g.text: A discrete CDF can converge to a continuous limit
Blue: exact finite CDF (jumps shown vertically). Red: standard-normal CDF.
D = sup |F_n - Phi|, evaluated on both sides of every jump; not a sampling error.
